name: Enterprise Fund Committee Special Meeting Agenda 9-11-2019
agenda_text:
CITY OF EL MONTE

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA
  ENTERPRISE FUND COMMITTEE
  SEPTEMBER 11, 2019 – 6:00 p.m.
  El Monte City Hall West
  Conference Room A
  11333 Valley Boulevard
  El Monte, California
1.  CALL TO ORDER

2.  ROLL CALL

3.  FLAG SALUTE

4.  APPROVAL OF AGENDA

5.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  Regular Meeting Minutes of July 23, 2019

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A. Introduction of new Utility Manager
  B. Discussion of the following requests into upcoming CIP and Operations:
  • Replacement of 750’ mainline and services on Granada Street;
  • Blanketed PO for Engineering and Administrative Services;
  • Engineering: Upcoming projects (mainline improvements, water master
  plan, integration of GIS, developing standards, upcoming CIP
  projects);
  • Seismic retrofit to 1MG reservoir (to include upgrade to booster
  station);
  • Asking for feasibility/bid on proprietary SCADA system;
  • Submittal of RFP for new Water Master Plan;
  • Update on current project status (Meter registers); and
  • New budget review

7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS

8.  ADJOURN MEETING

  Agenda Posted: September 9, 2019
